mentions.name: SearchSpot
mentions.description: SearchSpot is a "travel confidence engine" ("Cursor for travel") that automates travel research: it cross-checks reviews, verifies real photos, and compares prices across platforms, then transparently shows its reasoning so users understand why something was recommended or excluded. The goal is to help travelers close their tabs and book with confidence.
mentions.problem: Travel decisions involve opening 20+ tabs across Booking, Google Maps, Reddit, and Instagram to answer simple questions like whether an area is right or a hotel is good; existing tools either oversimplify (unverifiable ChatGPT-style answers) or hide information behind OTA algorithms and commissions, which removes choice and makes people less confident.
mentions.audience: Consumers and power travelers planning trips who currently research across multiple sites and struggle to book with confidence.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building SearchSpot, a "Cursor for travel." It automatically does what power travelers already do manually — cross-check reviews, verify real photos, compare prices across platforms — and then shows its reasoning transparently so you understand why something was recommended or excluded.
